commit.message:
Adds this.mode for webpack loaders

Pretty straightforward. But a number of loaders depend on it including

- postcss-loader
- sass-loader
- stylus-loader
- vue-loader
- nunjucks-loader
- thread-loader

-- [`mode`](https://webpack.js.org/api/loaders/#thismode) - No support
 
 **Utilities:**

@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
+
+export default function Root({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
+  return (
+    <html>
+      <body>{children}</body>
+    </html>
+  )
+}

@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+export default 'loader did not run'

@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+import type { NextConfig } from 'next'
+
+const loader = require.resolve('./mode-loader.js')
+
+const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
+  turbopack: {
+    rules: {
+      '*.mode-test.js': {
+        loaders: [loader],
+        as: '*.js',
+      },
+    },
+  },
+  webpack(config) {
+    config.module.rules.push({
+      test: /\.mode-test\.js$/,
+      use: loader,
+    })
+    return config
+  },
+}
+
+export default nextConfig

@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+import { nextTestSetup } from 'e2e-utils'
+
+describe('webpack-loader-mode', () => {
+  const { next, isNextDev } = nextTestSetup({
+    files: __dirname,
+  })
+
+  it('exposes the compilation mode to loaders', async () => {
+    const $ = await next.render$('/')
+    expect($('#mode').text()).toBe(isNextDev ? 'development' : 'production')
+  })
+})
